description: This file defines a custom implementation of a SageMaker-based language model class, including utilities for parsing byte streams, handling inference requests, streaming responses, and integrating with callback mechanisms.

classes.name: LineIterator
classes.description: A helper class for parsing byte stream input from a TGI container, handling concatenation of partial JSON objects across stream events.

classes.name: SagemakerLLM
classes.description: A class representing a SageMaker inference endpoint model, supporting text completion, streaming, and chat functionalities with AWS SageMaker.

methods.name: LineIterator.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the line iterator with a byte stream.

methods.name: LineIterator.__next__
methods.description: Retrieves the next line from the stream, handling partial JSON objects.

methods.name: SagemakerLLM.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the SageMaker LLM with configuration parameters and AWS client.

methods.name: SagemakerLLM.metadata
methods.description: Returns metadata about the LLM, including context window and model name.

methods.name: SagemakerLLM.complete
methods.description: Performs a non-streaming completion request to the SageMaker endpoint.

methods.name: SagemakerLLM.stream_complete
methods.description: Streams completion responses from the SageMaker endpoint, yielding partial results.

methods.name: SagemakerLLM.chat
methods.description: Performs a chat completion using the message sequence.

methods.name: SagemakerLLM.stream_chat
methods.description: Streams chat responses based on message sequence.
